verses.1: To David, the LORD will fight against his enemies for him. He will avenge his wounds.
verses.2: The strong one will protect and defend, and stand firm with my help.
verses.3: And let the enemy be shut in, so that he cannot see my pursuers. I say to my soul: “Your salvation is near.”
verses.4: They will be deceived and misled by those who seek to harm my soul. They will be defeated, and their evil thoughts will be revealed.
verses.5: They shall be like smoke before the wind, and the Lord will fill them with glory.
verses.6: May their path be dark and difficult, and may Jehovah pursue them relentlessly.
verses.7: For they have hidden their secrets from me; they have concealed them from my heart.
verses.8: It will be seen that he will not know, and those who are trapped in his schemes will fall into destruction.
verses.9: And my soul will find comfort in Jehovah’s salvation.
verses.10: All my enemies will say, “Who is like You, O LORD? You save the poor from those who are stronger than them. You also save the poor and the needy.”
verses.11: They arose to perform a task that I did not know about.
verses.12: May evil be replaced by good, so that all my thoughts may be filled with goodness.
verses.13: And I am in their suffering; I hold my heart tightly closed. My prayers are on my lips, and they will be answered.
verses.14: As a companion to my brother, I walked along the path of sorrow. But Koder was always there to comfort me.
verses.15: And in their hearts they rejoiced. They gathered around me, those who were sick. I didn’t know that they had been broken and destroyed.
verses.16: In the depths of despair, I am filled with sorrow and pain.
verses.17: Adonai, how many times will I see this return of my soul from those who deceive me?
verses.18: Hail you in a large crowd, among a whole people who praise you.
verses.19: May my enemies rejoice, for they are false and hateful. They will be punished for their actions.
verses.20: For it is not right for them to speak, and in the moments of time on earth, to say things that are false and misleading.
verses.21: And they spread their mouths wide over me. They said, “Oh, what a sight we have seen!”
verses.22: The LORD has seen that you are still faithful to me, and that you do not stray from me.
verses.23: The city rose up and went to court before the judgments of God and my Lord, in order to settle disputes.
verses.24: Judge me according to your righteousness, O LORD God. May no one rejoice over me.
verses.25: Let them not say in their hearts, “Our souls are safe.” Let them not say, “We are secure.”
verses.26: They will dig and search together, to uncover the secrets of my misfortune. They will plow through everything that increases my suffering.
verses.27: Let them rejoice and be glad, those who seek righteousness. Let them always say, “May the LORD increase His glory! He desires peace for His servants.”
verses.28: And let your righteousness be revealed today, your glory forever.
